thread:
matt-g: Rolling the v2 API cutover tonight at 23:00 PT. We'll enable the dynamic header negotiation + new payload schema. This is a gradual rollout with ops-eyes. Reply with any blockers.

raj: Quick Q — what happens for older clients that still send `X-API-Version: v1`?

matt-g: fallback path will route them to v1 service. We have a header-negotiation shim that inspects `X-API-Version` and `Accept-Version`. Default behaviour: if header missing -> v2; if `v1` -> route to v1. Deploy-bot will flip `header_negotiation=true`.

deploy-bot: scheduled deploy deploy-8312349999 at 2026-03-21T23:00:00Z. Rolling by region: us-west1 -> us-east1 -> eu-west1. Pause trigger config attached.

julie-pm: Added to release notes draft: "Clients: new header negotiation — servers will prefer v2 unless explicitly asked for v1." I'll link the doc in a sec. Anyone want wording tweaks? :memo:

anna-l: I'll add a short migration snippet and include an example curl.

raj: Will cookie-based clients (mobile SDKs) be affected? They sometimes omit headers.

matt-g: Mobile SDKs are on the compatibility list. If header is omitted we default to v2; mobile SDKs were tested in canary last week and passed but please watch for regressions.

ops: infra check: reserved capacity at 78% in us-west1, autoscale buffer set to +40% for the rollout window. We also pre-warmed an extra shard for KV cache to avoid cold-cache p95 spikes.

sre-oncall: Rollback criteria proposal: trigger rollback if any of the following within a 5m sliding window:
- client-visible 5xx > 1.0%
- p95 latency increase > 2x baseline for two consecutive 1m buckets
- error rate spike concentrated in a single tenant > 0.5% of overall traffic
If triggered: immediate header pin to v1 for traffic and execute `./playbooks/v2-cutover rollback` and notify pager.

matt-g: +1 to criteria. Add a manual operator rollback step in the runbook (cmds below).

anna-l: Runbook snippet (will paste into docs):
```
# Operator rollback - v2 cutover
deploy-bot set header_negotiation=false --id=deploy-8312349999
deploy-bot pin-version --target=v1 --reason="rollback-trigger"
kubectl rollout restart deployment/service-router -n prod
```

deploy-bot: pause-window enabled: auto-pause if any region reports 5xx > 0.7% for 3m. Notify channel and create rollback ticket if paused.

julie-pm: Ops-eyes window: 30m after final region flip. We'll schedule a summary update at +15m and +30m. If all green, we'll cut release notes to stable and close the ticket.

raj: One more ask — can we add a short telemetry tag so clients can report when they intentionally request v1? Helps with post-cutover metrics.

matt-g: Good call. We'll add `client_requested_version` tag to logs and metrics for 48h post-cutover.

ops: one note — API gateway has a header normalization rule; make sure it doesn't lowercase `Accept-Version` unexpectedly. I filed a small config tweak PR: https://git.internal/r/1234 :eyes:

anna-l: I'll add a caller note in release notes: "If you see 400s after cutover, confirm your gateway is not dropping Accept-Version header (case-sensitive mismatch)."

sre-oncall: I'll stand by during the window. Paging rules already updated to include the new rollback playbook.

matt-g: Thanks team — proceeding with scheduled rollout. Ops-eyes assigned: @ops @sre-oncall. If anyone sees odd spikes call the rollback. :rocket:
